name: Potatoes Colcannon
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Separately boil the potatoes and greens until tender. Drain both.
Squeeze as much liquid as possible out of the greens, then finely chop them.
Combine the potatoes, chopped greens, butter, pepper, and salt. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a greased mold, then bake in a hot oven for 10 minutes.
